lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with 4-6 primary spots per column visible on the upper lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance circular blobs to form a semi-regular grid-like topology across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient from upper specular highlight to lower shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density of small, lower-contrast high-luminance blobs distributed across the anterior and medial surfaces of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense concentration of high-luminance, small-diameter spots on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
